package __PACKAGE__;

// Postgres access for the operations designed on this service. Generated by Tessery.
// Rows come back as JSON built by Postgres, and every value goes in as text with a cast to the
// column's type, so Postgres does all type conversion.

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariConfig;
import com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariDataSource;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.postgresql.util.PSQLException;

public final class Db {
    private Db() {}

    /** A status code and a JSON body ready to send; a null body means no content. */
    public record Result(int status, String body) {}

    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger("db");
    private static final ObjectMapper JSON = new ObjectMapper();
    private static final String MIGRATIONS = "migrations/__MIGRATIONS_DIR__";
    private static final long MIGRATION_LOCK = 727274L;
    private static HikariDataSource pool;

    /** Connects to the postgres:// address and applies each migration that has not run yet, in order. Replicas wait on a lock. */
    public static void open(String address) {
        URI u = URI.create(address.replaceFirst("^postgres(ql)?://", "http://"));
        HikariConfig c = new HikariConfig();
        c.setJdbcUrl("jdbc:postgresql://" + u.getHost() + ":" + (u.getPort() > 0 ? u.getPort() : 5432) + u.getPath() + (u.getRawQuery() != null ? "?" + u.getRawQuery() : ""));
        if (u.getRawUserInfo() != null) {
            String[] parts = u.getRawUserInfo().split(":", 2);
            c.setUsername(URLDecoder.decode(parts[0], StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (parts.length > 1) c.setPassword(URLDecoder.decode(parts[1], StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
        c.setMaximumPoolSize(10);
        c.setInitializationFailTimeout(-1);
        pool = new HikariDataSource(c);
        for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
            try {
                migrate();
                return;
            } catch (MigrationFailed e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e.getMessage(), e);
            } catch (SQLException | IOException e) {
                if (attempt >= 30) throw new IllegalStateException("migrating: " + e.getMessage(), e);
                LOG.info("database not ready (" + e.getMessage() + "), retrying in 2s");
                try { Thread.sleep(2000); } catch (InterruptedException i) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return; }
            }
        }
    }

    private static final class MigrationFailed extends RuntimeException {
        MigrationFailed(String file, Exception e) { super("migration " + file + " failed: " + e.getMessage(), e); }
    }

    private static String resource(String path) throws IOException {
        try (InputStream in = Db.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(path)) {
            if (in == null) return null;
            try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                return r.lines().collect(Collectors.joining("\n"));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void migrate() throws SQLException, IOException {
        String index = resource(MIGRATIONS + "/index.txt");
        if (index == null) return;
        try (Connection conn = pool.getConnection()) {
            try (Statement s = conn.createStatement()) {
                s.execute("SELECT pg_advisory_lock(" + MIGRATION_LOCK + ")");
            }
            try {
                try (Statement s = conn.createStatement()) {
                    s.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _tessery_migrations (name text PRIMARY KEY, applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())");
                }
                for (String name : index.split("\n")) {
                    name = name.trim();
                    if (name.isEmpty()) continue;
                    try (PreparedStatement p = conn.prepareStatement("SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _tessery_migrations WHERE name = ?)")) {
                        p.setString(1, name);
                        try (ResultSet r = p.executeQuery()) { r.next(); if (r.getBoolean(1)) continue; }
                    }
                    String sql = resource(MIGRATIONS + "/" + name);
                    if (sql == null) throw new MigrationFailed(name, new IOException("missing from the build"));
                    conn.setAutoCommit(false);
                    try (Statement s = conn.createStatement(); PreparedStatement p = conn.prepareStatement("INSERT INTO _tessery_migrations (name) VALUES (?)")) {
                        s.execute(sql);
                        p.setString(1, name);
                        p.executeUpdate();
                        conn.commit();
                    } catch (SQLException e) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        throw new MigrationFailed(name, e);
                    } finally {
                        conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                    }
                    LOG.info("applied migration " + name);
                }
            } finally {
                try (Statement s = conn.createStatement()) {
                    s.execute("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(" + MIGRATION_LOCK + ")");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Result error(int status, Map<String, String> fields) {
        try {
            return new Result(status, JSON.writeValueAsString(fields));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            return new Result(status, "{\"error\":\"internal\"}");
        }
    }

    static final Result NOT_FOUND = error(404, Map.of("error", "not_found"));

    static Result rejected(SQLException e) {
        String code = e.getSQLState() == null ? "" : e.getSQLState();
        String detail = e instanceof PSQLException p && p.getServerErrorMessage() != null ? p.getServerErrorMessage().getDetail() : null;
        String column = e instanceof PSQLException p && p.getServerErrorMessage() != null ? p.getServerErrorMessage().getColumn() : null;
        if (code.equals("23502") && column != null) return error(400, Map.of("error", "invalid", "field", column, "detail", column + " is required"));
        if (code.equals("23505")) return error(409, Map.of("error", "already_exists", "detail", detail == null ? "" : detail));
        if (code.equals("23503")) return error(409, Map.of("error", "reference_not_found", "detail", detail == null ? "" : detail));
        if (code.startsWith("22") || code.startsWith("23") || code.equals("42703")) return error(400, Map.of("error", "invalid", "detail", e.getMessage()));
        LOG.warning("database error: " + e.getMessage());
        return error(500, Map.of("error", "internal"));
    }

    static String quote(String name) { return "\"" + name.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\""; }

    static String snake(String k) { return k.replaceAll("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "$1_$2").toLowerCase(); }

    static String text(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return null;
        if (v instanceof String s) return s;
        if (v instanceof Boolean || v instanceof Number) return v.toString();
        try { return JSON.writeValueAsString(v); } catch (IOException e) { return v.toString(); }
    }

    /** Reads a JSON object body; anything else counts as empty. */
    static Map<String, Object> readBody(String body) {
        if (body == null || body.isBlank()) return Map.of();
        try {
            Object v = JSON.readValue(body, Object.class);
            if (v instanceof Map<?, ?> m) {
                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                m.forEach((k, x) -> out.put(String.valueOf(k), x));
                return out;
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // not JSON: treated as empty
        }
        return Map.of();
    }

    /** Query keys a list understands besides column names. */
    static final Set<String> RESERVED = Set.of("limit", "offset", "page", "q", "sort");

    static boolean textType(String t) { return t.equals("text") || t.equals("citext") || t.startsWith("varchar") || t.startsWith("character"); }

    static String like(String s) { return "%" + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_") + "%"; }

    public record Table(String name, String key, String order, Map<String, String> types, List<String> writable) {
        String cast(String col) { return "?::text::" + types.getOrDefault(col, "text"); }

        private String where(Map<String, String> filter, List<String> args) {
            List<String> parts = new ArrayList<>();
            filter.forEach((k, v) -> { parts.add(quote(k) + " = " + cast(k)); args.add(v); });
            return String.join(" AND ", parts);
        }

        private Result one(int status, String sql, List<String> args) {
            try (Connection c = pool.getConnection(); PreparedStatement p = c.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                for (int i = 0; i < args.size(); i++) p.setString(i + 1, args.get(i));
                try (ResultSet r = p.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!r.next() || r.getString(1) == null) return NOT_FOUND;
                    return new Result(status, r.getString(1));
                }
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                return rejected(e);
            }
        }

        private Map<String, String> pick(Map<String, Object> body) {
            Map<String, String> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            body.forEach((k, v) -> { String c = snake(k); if (writable.contains(c) && !c.equals(key)) out.put(c, text(v)); });
            return out;
        }

        private static int number(String v, int fallback) {
            try { return v == null ? fallback : Integer.parseInt(v.trim()); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { return fallback; }
        }

        /** ?q= searches text columns, ?column= filters, ?sort=column or -column orders, ?page= or ?offset= with ?limit= pages. */
        public Result list(Map<String, String> q, Map<String, String> filter) {
            int limit = Math.min(Math.max(number(q.get("limit"), 50), 1), 500);
            int offset = q.containsKey("offset") ? Math.max(number(q.get("offset"), 0), 0) : (Math.max(number(q.get("page"), 1), 1) - 1) * limit;
            Map<String, String> match = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            q.forEach((k, v) -> { if (types.containsKey(k) && !RESERVED.contains(k) && v != null && !v.isEmpty()) match.put(k, v); });
            match.putAll(filter);
            List<String> args = new ArrayList<>();
            String where = where(match, args);
            String search = q.getOrDefault("q", "").trim();
            List<String> cols = types.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> textType(e.getValue())).map(Map.Entry::getKey).sorted().toList();
            if (!search.isEmpty() && !cols.isEmpty()) {
                String clause = "(" + cols.stream().map(c -> quote(c) + " ILIKE ?").collect(Collectors.joining(" OR ")) + ")";
                cols.forEach(c -> args.add(like(search)));
                where = where.isEmpty() ? clause : where + " AND " + clause;
            }
            String sortBy = order;
            String sort = q.getOrDefault("sort", "");
            String col = sort.startsWith("-") ? sort.substring(1) : sort;
            if (types.containsKey(col)) sortBy = quote(col) + (sort.startsWith("-") ? " DESC" : " ASC") + ", " + order;
            return one(200, "SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM " + quote(name) + (where.isEmpty() ? "" : " WHERE " + where)
                + " ORDER BY " + sortBy + " LIMIT " + limit + " OFFSET " + offset + ") r", args);
        }

        public Result get(String id, Map<String, String> filter) {
            List<String> args = new ArrayList<>();
            String where = where(withKey(filter, id), args);
            return one(200, "SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM " + quote(name) + " r WHERE " + where, args);
        }

        public Result create(String body, Map<String, String> fixed) {
            Map<String, String> cols = pick(readBody(body));
            cols.putAll(fixed);
            if (cols.isEmpty()) return one(201, "WITH r AS (INSERT INTO " + quote(name) + " DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", List.of());
            List<String> names = cols.keySet().stream().map(Db::quote).toList();
            List<String> params = cols.keySet().stream().map(this::cast).toList();
            return one(201, "WITH r AS (INSERT INTO " + quote(name) + " (" + String.join(", ", names) + ") VALUES (" + String.join(", ", params) + ") RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r",
                new ArrayList<>(cols.values()));
        }

        public Result update(String id, String body, Map<String, String> filter) {
            Map<String, String> cols = pick(readBody(body));
            if (cols.isEmpty()) return error(400, Map.of("error", "invalid", "detail", "nothing to update; writable fields are " + String.join(", ", writable)));
            List<String> args = new ArrayList<>(cols.values());
            String sets = cols.keySet().stream().map(c -> quote(c) + " = " + cast(c)).collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
            String where = where(withKey(filter, id), args);
            return one(200, "WITH r AS (UPDATE " + quote(name) + " SET " + sets + " WHERE " + where + " RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", args);
        }

        public Result remove(String id, Map<String, String> filter) {
            List<String> args = new ArrayList<>();
            String where = where(withKey(filter, id), args);
            try (Connection c = pool.getConnection(); PreparedStatement p = c.prepareStatement("DELETE FROM " + quote(name) + " WHERE " + where)) {
                for (int i = 0; i < args.size(); i++) p.setString(i + 1, args.get(i));
                return p.executeUpdate() == 0 ? NOT_FOUND : new Result(204, null);
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                return rejected(e);
            }
        }

        private Map<String, String> withKey(Map<String, String> filter, String id) {
            Map<String, String> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            out.put(key, id);
            out.putAll(filter);
            return out;
        }
    }
}
